)

title: DTC CREATIVE STRATEGIST
description:
We're an Australian beauty brand doing $500K/month. By 2027, we'll be at $2M/month, expanding into new markets, new channels, new angles that nobody in our category is running.

We don't need someone to "help with creative." We need the person who becomes the reason our ads print money.



WHAT THIS ACTUALLY IS



You'll own the entire creative pipeline. Not just briefs, but the thinking that makes briefs dangerous.

Mine for gold in Reddit threads, Amazon reviews, TikTok comments, customer calls. You'll find the emotional triggers our competitors are sleeping on and turn them into angles that stop cold traffic dead.

Testing hooks to CTAs, every frame earns the next second. You'll write for UGC creators and our other video editors who will report directly to you. YOU are the one running your own team alongside our founder.

Brief with precision. Your briefs shouldn't leave room for guesswork. Editors execute because your direction is that clear.

Read the data, find the signal. You'll live inside the ad account with our founder. Hook rate, hold rate, CPA, ROAS. You'll know exactly why something worked and feed that insight straight back into the next round of tests.

Scale what wins. When an angle hits, you don't celebrate. You spin 10 variations and push harder before fatigue sets in.

Test at volume. We move fast. You'll be pushing multiple new concepts per week across Meta, TikTok, and emerging platforms as we enter new markets.

This isn't a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it convert" role with a direct line to revenue.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You've done this before. You've scaled creative at a DTC brand or agency and you can point to the ads that worked and tell us why.



You:



Have 2+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in beauty, skincare, wellness, or health in competitive paid social environments

Understand Meta and TikTok creative strategy at a deep level: hooks, angles, formats, fatigue cycles, platform nuance

Can write ad scripts that convert cold traffic, not just entertain warm audiences

Obsess over creative performance data. You pull insights, not just reports

Communicate sharp and fast. Your briefs are tight, your Slack messages are clear, your feedback loops are closed the same day

Have experience (or serious hunger) working across international markets like AU, US, UK, and beyond

Want to grow into a Creative Director or Head of Creative role as we scale. This is a ground-floor seat at a brand going from strong to dominant

Treat this like it's your brand. You show up like an owner, not an employee



Bonus points:



You've worked in the Australian or APAC beauty market

You have experience scaling into the US or UK from a non-US base

You understand influencer and UGC ecosystems across multiple markets

You've used AI tools to accelerate creative workflows



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



If you need to be told what to test, don't apply

If you take 3 days to turn around a brief, don't apply

If blunt feedback makes you spiral, don't apply

If you've never worked on ads that had real spend behind them, don't apply

If you think "strategy" means a deck with no execution, don't apply

If you want a coasting gig with no accountability, this will eat you alive



COMPENSATION

Base: $1,000/week ($4,333/month)

Plus uncapped bonuses on every winning ad.

Your ads scale, you earn more. There is no ceiling. The structure rewards volume, quality, and results. The trifecta that separates strategists from brief-fillers.

We'll also invest in your growth: courses, masterminds, tools. Whatever makes you sharper, we'll cover it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're at $500K/month with a product that converts and a brand that resonates. The creative engine is what takes us to $2M/month and beyond, across multiple markets. You won't be inheriting someone else's playbook. You'll be writing it.

One seat. Long-term. If you're the right strategist, you'll look back on this as the role that changed everything.

TO APPLY

Send us:



A short Loom (under 3 minutes) breaking down one ad you've created or strategised that crushed it. What was the angle, why it worked, and what you'd test next.

Your portfolio or examples of ads you've been responsible for (strategy, scripts, or both)

A one-paragraph answer: What's the first thing you'd do in your first week with us?



No cover letters. No CVs full of job titles. Show us how you think.

title: Simpro Expert (2-Week Contract)
description:
About Us

We are an Australian-based solar and electrical company implementing Simpro to run operations end-to-end. The system is partially set up, but we have issues with inventory and job management, and we need reliable gross profit per job reporting.

Contract Summary

• Role: Simpro Expert (Implementation + Training)

• Location: Remote (Philippines)

• Working hours: Must overlap with AEST (to be agreed)

• Commercials: Fixed project fee (negotiable for the right person)

• Start: ASAP

Scope (What You Will Deliver)

1) Inventory: make stock and cost flows accurate

• Audit current inventory setup and identify what is breaking accuracy (items, cost methods, stock movements, allocations to jobs).

• Fix configuration and workflows so inventory movements map correctly into job costing.

• Clean up critical data issues (item naming, duplicates, units of measure, cost fields) where required.

2) Job management workflow: enforce consistent costing capture

• Finalize and standardize job lifecycle (statuses, templates, mandatory fields, permissions).

• Ensure materials, labour, and subcontractor costs are captured consistently per job.

• Confirm the process works end-to-end from job creation to close-out.

3) Gross profit per job reporting (core outcome)

• Implement or correct reporting so we can see gross profit per job with confidence.

• Validate report accuracy using a sample set of real jobs.

• Deliver a repeatable reporting process (who runs it, when, what gets checked).

Reporting must include (minimum)

• Job ID / Job name

• Customer

• Job status (open/closed)

• Revenue

• COGS breakdown (materials, labour, subcontractors) if Simpro supports this cleanly in your configuration

• Gross profit ($)

• Gross margin (%) = Gross profit / Revenue

Deliverables (End of Week 2)

• Inventory workflow working and documented (tested transactions and job allocations).

• Job management workflow stable (templates, statuses, permissions, required fields).

• Gross profit per job report delivered with:

• A “source of truth” report/dashboard

• A reconciliation checklist

title: UX/Graphic Designer
description:
Context

Working across a diverse portfolio of client accounts, this role is the creative engine that transforms client business goals into functional, high-impact designs. In an agency environment, this position requires the agility to switch between different brand voices and the strategic thinking to solve unique user experience challenges for various industries simultaneously.



Role Purpose

The UX/Graphic Designer is responsible for conceptualising and executing design solutions that meet specific client briefs. You will balance the "look" (Graphic Design) with the "logic" (UX Design) to ensure that every asset -- whether a landing page, a social campaign, or a brand identity -- is optimised for the client’s target audience and business objectives.



Work of the Role

Multi-Brand Design: Developing creative assets for a variety of clients, ensuring each piece aligns strictly with their specific brand identity and tone.



UX Strategy & Wireframing: Building user flows and wireframes for client websites and apps to improve navigation and conversion.



High-Fidelity UI Design: Creating polished, modern interfaces in Figma/Adobe XD that are ready for developer handoff.



Marketing Collateral: Designing high-performing ad creative,
 templates, and sales decks that drive results for client campaigns.



Client Presentation: Articulating design concepts and UX logic to clients, explaining how your creative decisions solve their business problems.



Iterative Optimisation: Using client feedback and data (Heatmaps, Google Analytics) to refine designs and improve performance post-launch.



Collaborative Sprints: Working closely with Account Managers, Google Ads Specialists, and Developers to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Quality Control: Ensuring all files are delivered to spec (print or digital) and maintaining organised asset libraries for every client.



Outcomes and Measures

Client Retention & Satisfaction: High marks on client feedback surveys regarding the quality and creativity of design work.



Efficiency: Managing time effectively across multiple projects, meeting all internal and client deadlines without compromising quality.



Technical Accuracy: Minimal revisions required due to technical errors or failure to follow the creative brief.



Collaboration: Seamless handoffs to the development team with clearly documented design systems and components.



Skills and Requirements

2 to 4 years of experience in a design role, preferably within a fast-paced agency environment.

Dual-Skill Mastery: A portfolio that shows a mix of beautiful graphic design (branding/layout) and smart UX thinking (user flows/prototypes).

Software Proficiency: Advanced skills in Figma (or Adobe XD) and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

Adaptability: The ability to pivot between different industries and design styles quickly and effectively.

Time Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once while staying organised and meeting deadlines.

Communication: Comfortable presenting work to clients and taking constructive feedback with a professional, solution-oriented mindset.

title: Google Ads Specialist / PPC Specialist
description:
Context

By combining analytical expertise, operational efficiency, and strategic insight, this role ensures our advertising campaigns deliver strong results while maintaining smooth workflows and clear communication. The role bridges marketing strategy and hands-on campaign management to help drive growth for our clients.



Role Purpose

The Google Ads Specialist is responsible for managing, optimising, and reporting on Google Ads campaigns to achieve client goals. This includes keyword research, ad copy creation, bid management, performance analysis, and conversion tracking. The role ensures campaigns are executed with precision, delivering measurable results while contributing to internal team efficiency and client satisfaction.



Work of the Role

- Setting up, managing, and optimising Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, etc.) to meet performance targets.

- Conducting keyword research and audience targeting to ensure maximum campaign effectiveness.

- Writing compelling ad copy and creating variations for A/B testing.

- Monitoring campaign performance daily, identifying issues or opportunities, and implementing data-driven optimisations.

- Managing conversion tracking setups, including Google Tag Manager, to ensure accurate measurement and reporting.

- Preparing regular performance reports with insights and recommendations for improvement.

- Coordinating with internal teams to ensure campaigns align with overall marketing and business strategies.

- Maintaining organised campaign records, tracking time accurately, and meeting deadlines.

- Proactively suggesting improvements to processes, strategies, and account structures to boost ROI.



Outcomes and Measures

- Campaigns set up and launched accurately, on time, and following best practices.

- Performance metrics (CTR, CPC, ROAS, Conversion Rate) consistently meet or exceed client goals.

- Conversion tracking implemented correctly, with minimal discrepancies.

- Regular performance reports delivered on schedule, with actionable insights.

- Positive client feedback on campaign results and communication.

- Continuous optimisation efforts demonstrated through documented tests, iterations, and improvements.



Skills and Requirements

- 1–2 years of experience managing Google Ads campaigns (Search & Display required; Performance Max and YouTube are a plus).

- Proven track record of improving campaign performance through data-driven optimisation.

- Familiarity with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for conversion tracking.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to draw insights from data.

- Excellent attention to detail in campaign setup and reporting.

- Strong organisational and time management skills, able to handle multiple accounts or campaigns simultaneously.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative and proactive approach.

- Google Ads certification is an advantage but not required.

 campaigns on
/Instagram to re?engage website visitors.

title: Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home
description:
Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home



Important: Please Read This Full Position Brief Before Applying



We will only consider applicants who read and follow the full instructions in this job description.



If you do not follow the application requirements exactly, your application will not be considered and may be marked as spam.



About the Role

We are hiring a work-from-home Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist.



This is not cold calling. You will be contacting warm leads who have responded to our advertising, usually during the same day or the previous day. These leads have already shown interest and understand that they have made an inquiry.



Your main role is to call as many leads as possible throughout the day, speak with potential clients, and qualify whether they may be eligible for a Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim to be developed by our legal team.



Calls are made through a dial pad inside our CRM. Each tea
mber is provided with their own access so calls can be tracked and monitored.



The Person We Are Looking For

We need someone who is a self-starter, confident on the phone, organised, and able to approach the role with enthusiasm and tenacity.



Success in this role is measured by:



Calls made

Leads qualified

Client sign-ups

Accurate follow-up work

Strong organisation and communication

Exceptional, fluent spoken English is essential. If you are not able to confidently and fluently converse in English, please do not apply.



Additional Admin Responsibilities

Once a client is qualified, there are administrative steps that must be completed. This includes gathering information from the client, sending initial inquiries to insurers and superannuation funds, and staying on top of follow-up tasks.



You will work closely with our Philippines-based admin team and our Sydney-based legal team. You will help make sure matters continue moving through the process, including following up on medical certificates, employment records, insurer information, superannuation fund responses, and other required documents.



There may be times when all leads have been contacted before the end of the day. When that happens, you will be expected to move into admin-related work. Flexibility is very important in this role.



Hours and Working Arrangement

This is a contracted work-from-home role.



Hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sydney time.



As a contractor, you are responsible for your own equipment, internet connection, local obligations, and working setup in the Philippines.



We are a stable and mature company with strong long-term prospects for remote work. The role includes two weeks of vacation time over Christmas, pro-rated depending on your start date, as well as agreed holiday time.



Tools and Training Provided

We will provide access to:



CRM

Legal CRM

DocuSign

Dialpad

Training to get you up to speed

Strict Application Requirements

To apply, you must
 your application to:







Your
 subject line must be:



Application - Outbound Dialer - [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:



An up-to-date CV

A short covering letter

An original 60-second voice recording reading the script below

The recording must be made specifically for this job application. Do not send an old recording, a generic voice sample, or an AI-generated recording.



Script for Voice Recording

“Hi, my name is [your name], and I’m calling in relation to your recent inquiry about a possible Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim.



I just need to ask you a few quick questions to understand your situation and see whether this may be something our team can assist with.



The call should only take a few minutes. I’ll go through some basic details with you, and if it looks like you may qualify, our team can explain the next steps and what information may be needed.



Is now still a good time to speak?”



Final Note

Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered and may be marked as spam.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: 

- Instagram: 



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between May 30 – June 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

title: Online Academic Tutor (Math and/or Science)
description:
We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Online Academic Tutor to deliver high-quality virtual instruction in Mathematics and/or Science to students from Kindergarten through to Year 12 across Australia. The ideal candidate will foster confidence, curiosity, and a love for learning by delivering engaging and interactive lessons aligned with the Australian Curriculum.



This role offers flexibility, allowing tutors to specialize in Mathematics, Science, or both subjects, depending on their expertise and experience.



Responsibilities:

1. Deliver engaging, age-appropriate online lessons in Mathematics and/or Science to students from Kindergarten to Year 12.

2. Develop and implement customized lesson plans based on the Australian Curriculum and individual student learning needs.

3. Reinforce key concepts based on subject expertise:

- Mathematics: numeracy, algebra, geometry, statistics, calculus, and problem-solving

- Science: biology, chemistry, physics, environmental science, and general scientific inquiry

4. Simplify complex concepts using interactive teaching strategies, visual aids, and digital learning resources.

5. Assess student understanding and provide regular, constructive feedback to support academic improvement.

6. Prepare engaging learning materials, exercises, quizzes, and assessments suitable for online learning.

7. Monitor and maintain accurate records of student progress, attendance, and performance outcomes.

8. Communicate regularly with parents or guardians regarding student development and areas for improvement.

9. Encourage critical thinking, analytical skills, and confidence in learning.

10. Participate in tea
etings, training sessions, and ongoing professional development initiatives.



Qualifications

1. Bachelor’s degree in Education, Mathematics, Science, or a related field; teaching qualification or relevant certification preferred.

2. Experience teaching or tutoring Mathematics and/or Science to Kindergarten, Primary, or Secondary students (online teaching experience highly regarded).

3. Strong understanding of the Australian Curriculum in Mathematics and/or Science.

4. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

5. Proficiency in online teaching tools such as Zoom, Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams, or similar platforms.

6. Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional home teaching environment.

7. Patient, adaptable, and passionate about helping students succeed academically.

title: Top-Tier Short-Form Video Ad Editor for Medspa Clients
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled short-form video ad editor who can create premium, aesthetic, high-converting video ads for medspa clients.



Our agency works with medspas and aesthetic clinics, and we need someone who understands how to make ads that feel clean, polished, trustworthy, and visually engaging — not cheap, generic, or overly salesy.

* Experience editing short-form video ads

* A strong eye for premium, aesthetic visuals

* Understanding of hooks, pacing, text overlays, voiceovers, and CTAs

, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and TikTok

title: We're a 6-Figure Dropshipping Brand. We Need a Customer Support Specialist Who Knows Shopify and Disputes
description:
We run health and beauty dropshipping stores and we're looking for a customer support specialist who actually understands how this business model works, not someone who needs it explained to them. You'll be the first and last line of contact between us and our customers, and your judgment, tone, and speed will determine whether a dispute stays a dispute or becomes a chargeback we can't recover from.



This is a high-ownership role. Every
 you write represents our company. Every interaction you handle either builds trust or burns it. We need someone who can think independently, read a situation quickly, and craft a response that actually resolves things, not someone who only pastes a template and hopes for the best.



What you'll do day to day:



-Handle all inbound customer
s: complaints, order inquiries, refund requests, product questions, with professionalism and speed



-Monitor and respond to Klarna and PayPal disputes before they escalate to formal chargebacks, following platform-specific resolution strategies



-Navigate the Shopify admin to look up orders, check fulfilment status, coordinate with suppliers where needed, and update customers accurately



-De-escalate frustrated or angry customers, understand what they actually want and find a resolution that works for both sides



-Identify recurring complaint patterns and flag them internally so we can address root causes upstream



-Keep detailed records of disputes, resolutions, and outcomes for reporting and platform evidence purposes



What you must bring:



-Shopify experience: you know your way around the admin, can read order timelines, check fulfilment status, and understand how the platform works end to end



-Handle refund requests, missing order claims, product complaints, and shipping delays in line with our policies



-Klarna and PayPal dispute resolution: hands-on experience responding to disputes on both platforms, ideally with a track record of getting cases closed before they escalate



-Dropshipping business model knowledge: you understand longer shipping times, supplier-side delays, how fulfilment works, and you can explain these realities to customers in a way that doesn't lose their trust



-Health and beauty niche experience: familiarity with the types of customers, product expectations, common complaints that come with this category and refund/return prevention strategies for health/beauty products



-Native or near-native English writing: flawless grammar, natural tone, and the ability to adapt your writing style to the customer in front of you because your words are our brand voice



-Multilingual inbox handling: confident using translation tools (DeepL, Chatgpt or similair) and, critically able to review and rewrite translated responses so they sound human, culturally appropriate, and on-brand before hitting send



-Critical thinking under pressure: every customer situation is different; you know how to read what's really being said and respond to that, not just the surface complaint



-De-escalation skills: you've handled genuinely angry customers and you know how to bring the temperature down without making promises you can't keep



Please read this before applying!

We are not looking for someone to copy-paste AI responses or templated replies. Every customer
 requires its own read of the situation and a genuinely tailored response. If you don't have direct experience with Klarna and PayPal dispute resolution, Shopify order management, and the dropshipping model, please don't apply. We respect your time and ask you to respect ours. Unserious applications will not receive a response.



Nice to have:



-Experience with Re:Amaze or similar customer support helpdesk tools



-Familiarity with chargeback evidence submission processes (POD, tracking,
 logs + evidence explanation)



-Background working with international customers across different time zones



-Experience handling and preventing returns and refunds in a health/beauty dropshipping context



Pay: $4–$6 USD per hour depending on experience. Performance bonuses are on the table for candidates who consistently close disputes, keep chargeback rates low, and maintain high customer satisfaction. If you're good at this job, you'll earn more than the base rate.



How to apply: Send us a short cover message (not a template) that tells us about a specific dispute or difficult customer situation you handled, what the situation was, what you did, and what the outcome was. If you can't think of a real example, this role probably isn't the right fit. Applications without a real example will not be considered.

title: Financial Operations Manager (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred / Manila Based)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: ~25 Hours Per Week

Job Location:  Remote (Manila-based candidates only)

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment.



This is a hands-on role focused on maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end reporting, and ensuring finance workflows operate smoothly and efficiently.



Role Overview 



This role suits someone organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination, and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 20–25 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities and the successful candidate’s capability and availability.



Job Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows.

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate, reliable finance data.



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Role Purpose

We have already built the foundations of an AI-driven operating system, including an internal Topweld quoting skill, a 13-machine costing model with TCO-based rates, and standardised document formats. What we now need is an automation specialist who can wire these foundations into our day-to-day Microsoft 365 environment, so that
s, invoices, and quotes move through the business with minimal manual handling.

The role is delivery-focused. The successful candidate will work directly with the director, build automations inside Microsoft 365 using Power Automate and the Claude API, document every workflow as a written operating procedure, and transfer ownership to the internal team. No custom web apps, no separate databases, no bespoke development outside the Microsoft 365 stack.

Priority Workstreams

The role begins with three priority workstreams. The director's expectation is that each workstream is delivered, accepted, and handed over before the next begins, with a target of two weeks per workstream subject to feedback turnaround. Candidates are invited to propose a faster sequence if they can justify it.

Workstream 1 – Inbox Triage and Client Communications

Topweld receives RFQs, supplier correspondence, project updates, and internal traffic across two shared mailboxes 
 
 is rising as the business grows, and a structured triage layer is overdue.

– Deploy automated monitoring of both shared inboxes via Power Automate.

– Use the Claude API to classify each incoming
 into defined categories, including quote requests, supplier correspondence, active project communications, internal traffic, and noise.

– Issue branded auto-acknowledgements on quote requests and new client enquiries with realistic response time expectations set by the director.

– Maintain a live SharePoint register of classified
s with sender, subject, category, classification confidence, and timestamp for follow-up tracking.

– Define escalation behaviour for high-priority categories and an after-hours handling rule.

Acceptance Criteria

– Category classification accurate on at least 90 percent of a 50
 back-test.

– Auto-acknowledgement issued within 5 minutes of receipt for any qualifying
.

– Live register populated automatically, queryable, and visible to the director without manual intervention.

– Written operating procedure delivered, covering monitoring, pausing, retraining, and ownership transfer.

Workstream 2 – Supplier Document Intelligence

Topweld receives supplier invoices, delivery dockets, and purchase order confirmations daily, currently handled manually. The objective is to lift this data out of PDFs and into structured form for reconciliation, procurement tracking, and bookkeeping handoff.

– Build an extraction workflow for supplier invoices arriving via
 or saved to SharePoint, using the Claude API for parsing.

– Extract supplier name, invoice number, invoice date, line items, GST, freight, and total.

– Write extracted data into a structured Excel workbook organised by supplier and month.

– Flag any invoice with missing fields, low confidence on totals, or formatting anomalies into an exception register for manual review.

– Validate the workflow against a sample of at least 20 invoices spanning our active supplier base.

Acceptance Criteria

– Extraction accuracy of 95 percent or higher on supplier name and invoice total.

– End-to-end processing time of 10 minutes or less from inbox to Excel entry.

– Exception register operating reliably so no invoice is silently misread or skipped.

– Written operating procedure delivered, covering new supplier onboarding, exception review, and Excel structure maintenance.

Workstream 3 – Quoting Automation

Topweld already has an internal quoting skill and machine costing model covering 13 machines (press brake, fiber laser, bandsaw, guillotine, plate roller, section roller, orbital welder, lathe, mill, drill press, MIG/TIG/stick welding, auto-feeder TIG, angle grinder) with TCO-based rates. The objective is to wire this into a workflow that drafts quotes automatically from incoming RFQs and delivers them to the director for review.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders







What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

mbers can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:

title: SOP & Operations Systems Specialist
description:
Trillet is looking for an SOP & Operations Systems Specialist to help turn repeated founder/team workflows into clear, usable operating systems.



This is not a generic VA role and not just a writing role. You will observe how work actually happens, ask clarifying questions, identify missing steps or unclear ownership, and turn messy workflows into SOPs, checklists, templates, process maps, QA rubrics, and training materials that the team can actually use.



The right person probably has experience as one of these:

- Operations Systems Specialist

- SOP / Process Documentation Specialist

- Business Process Analyst

- BPO Training or QA Lead

- Senior Operations VA / Founder Operations Partner

- Technical Documentation or Quality Systems Specialist



What you will work on:

- Review Loom recordings, meeting notes, screenshots, voice notes, call notes, and live walkthroughs.

- Interview tea
mbers to understand how recurring work is actually done.

- Turn messy instructions into clear SOPs, checklists, templates, process maps, and QA/training materials.

- Capture decision logic, not only clicks: why a workflow is handled a certain way, what qualifies for escalation, what exceptions matter, and who owns each step.

- Build and maintain a clean SOP/documentation library in tools such as Google Drive, Notion, ClickUp, Trainual, or similar.

- Identify unclear ownership, repeated questions, missing handoffs, and places where the process breaks.

- Keep documentation updated as the real workflow changes.



Examples of workflows you may document:

- Discovery call to internal brief

- Demo preparation and QA

- Customer follow-up process

- Quote and scope preparation

- HubSpot / CRM updates

- Internal handoffs between tea
mbers

- Bug, QA, and escalation workflows

- Repeated founder/operator tasks

- Admin and operations processes



What success looks like:

- Repeated work is documented clearly enough that another tea
mber can run it without asking the founder to re-explain it.

- SOPs are easy to find, easy to follow, and updated when reality changes.

- The team has fewer repeated questions and cleaner handoffs.

- Important workflows leave a written record instead of disappearing into calls, Slack, memory, or screenshots.

- Documentation reflects how the business actually operates, not an idealized version.



Required:

- Strong written English.

- Experience creating SOPs, workflow maps, process documentation, training guides, QA checklists, or operations manuals.

- Ability to simplify messy or unclear workflows into practical, step-by-step documentation.

- Comfortable working from Loom videos, call notes, screenshots, voice notes, and rough founder/team instructions.

- Comfortable asking careful clarifying questions when a process is incomplete or inconsistent.

- Strong attention to detail, ownership, and follow-through.

- Experience with Google Docs / Drive and at least one documentation or project tool such as Notion, ClickUp, Asana, Trainual, Confluence, Miro, L
, or similar.



Nice to have:

- Experience in BPO training, QA, operations, business process analysis, quality systems, compliance documentation, SaaS, startups, agencies, or service businesses.

- Experience with Scribe, Loom, Miro, L
, Whimsical, Trainual, Notion, ClickUp, or process mapping tools.

- Comfort using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude to help structure documentation, while checking accuracy carefully.



This role is for someone who likes structure, clarity, and systems. You should enjoy taking something messy and making it understandable. You should be able to work independently, but you should not guess when a process is unclear.



This role is not for someone who only wants to follow instructions, format documents, or work as a general admin assistant.



How to apply:

Please send:

1. Your resume 

2. examples of SOPs, workflow maps, training guides, QA checklists, or process documents you have personally created.

3. A short note describing a messy process you helped document or improve.

4. The tools you have used for SOPs, workflow mapping, documentation, QA, or training. This includes AI chatbots.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD for this role.

6. Your English level and preferred working hours.

title: Full-Time E-commerce Video Editor
description:
About Us

Cleriva is a fast growing e-commerce brand transforming respiratory wellness through innovative red light therapy solutions that ease congestion and elevate daily well-being. Creative thinking is at the heart of how we connect with our audience, and we constantly push to produce content that is fresh and engaging. We’re seeking a video editor who can bring original ideas to the table while delivering polished, high performing content. The ideal candidate is not only skilled and creative but also highly coachable, open to feedback, and eager to continue learning as our brand evolves



What You’ll Do

As a video editor, you’ll be at the center of our creative output, turning raw content and ideas into scroll stopping creatives and brand assets that drive real results. Your work will directly impact our revenue and brand presence across multiple platforms.





Your responsibilities will include:

- Creative Research & Inspiration

- Regularly study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, and other platforms to spot trends, hooks, and editing techniques.

- Bring new creative ideas to the team each week. New formats, transitions, captions, sound effects, and storytelling angles we haven’t tried yet.

- Video Editing for Performance

- Edit UGC style videos and direct-response ads for platforms like Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and content for our website.

- Focus on performance-driven editing with strong hooks, optimized pacing, clear CTAs, and audience specific storytelling.

- Adapt and version videos into multiple aspect ratios

- Graphic Design Support

- Use Canva (or similar tools) to create thumbnails, ad statics, and product imagery that match our brand identity.

- Design on-screen text, callouts, and graphics that enhance clarity and drive engagement.

- Creative Testing & Iteration

- Work closely with the marketing team to understand performance data and make informed edits that improve CTR, view-through rate, and conversions.

- Maintain a library of “winning” ad formats and help evolve them over time.

- Collaboration & Feedback

- Participate in creative meetings, pitch ideas, and refine concepts with the team.

- Be open to feedback, ask questions when unclear, and apply learnings to future projects.

- Speed & Efficiency

- Manage deadlines without sacrificing quality.

- Be proactive in spotting opportunities to improve workflows and creative output.



What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience editing for e-commerce brands (portfolio required: ads, demos, UGC, etc.)

- Strong attention to detail, with a creative eye and excellent communication skills

- Ability to follow direction precisely but also to bring ideas and refinements

- Remote editing setup (computer, software, internet)

- Bonus: Graphic design experience (especially in Canva or similar tools)

- If you don’t have a proficient e-commerce editing background, we kindly ask that you pass on this opportunity.



How We Hire

- Submit your application (CV, portfolio, and your expected hourly rate or salary range)

- If shortlisted, we’ll invite you to complete a paid test project. You’ll work with a provided script and instructions.

- Compensation will honor your proposed rate.

- Good creative instincts, clear communication, and a polished cut win the day.



Compensation & Growth

We believe in rewarding both quality of work and the measurable impact of your creative output. While exact base pay will be tailored to your experience, our structure is designed to be fair, transparent, and performance-driven.



Project-Based Compensation Model:

- On average, a completed one minute edited video is budgeted at approximately two hours of work, factoring in sourcing, editing, revisions, and delivery.

- More complex projects such as those requiring advanced motion graphics, heavy compositing, or brand-level polish are compensated at a higher rate to reflect the additional time and skill involved.

- Simple edits, such as minimal-adjustment UGC videos, are compensated proportionally while still ensuring fair pay for the time invested.

- Performance Bonuses (ROAS-Based):

- Bonuses are awarded only when a video meets or exceeds a set Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) threshold.

- Bonuses are incremental, meaning the higher the ROAS, the greater the bonus amount.

- Over time, these bonuses can significantly increase your earnings, with the potential to double your base salary if multiple videos consistently perform at high ROAS levels.



Career Development & Growth:

- Opportunities to take on higher level creative strategy, concept ownership, and leadership roles as the brand scales.

- Access to creative tools, training resources, and ongoing mentorship to help you refine your skills and grow professionally.



We look forward to seeing your work and possibly welcoming you to our creative team!

- More complex projects such as those requiring advanced motion graphics, heavy compositing, or brand-level polish are compensated at a higher rate to reflect the additional time and skill involved.

- Simple edits, such as minimal-adjustment UGC videos, are compensated proportionally while still ensuring fair pay for the time invested.

- Performance Bonuses (ROAS-Based):

- Bonuses are awarded only when a video meets or exceeds a set Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) threshold.

- Bonuses are incremental, meaning the higher the ROAS, the greater the bonus amount.

- Over time, these bonuses can significantly increase your earnings, with the potential to double your base salary if multiple videos consistently perform at high ROAS levels.



Career Development & Growth:

- Opportunities to take on higher level creative strategy, concept ownership, and leadership roles as the brand scales.

- Access to creative tools, training resources, and ongoing mentorship to help you refine your skills and grow professionally.



We look forward to seeing your work and possibly welcoming you to our creative team!

 sequences, lead routing)

• Solid understanding of local business marketing dynamics



????????????????????????????????????????



? PREFERRED SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED BUT VALUED)



• Prior experience in healthcare, homecare, senior care, or a regulated industry

• Familiarity with modern web builders: Webflow, Framer, v0, or similar

• Basic video editing (Shorts, Reels, short-form testimonial clips)

• Canva proficiency for ad creatives and social assets

• Experience structuring and improving local lead funnels

• Demonstrated track record of improving local map pack rankings



????????????????????????????????????????



???? HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



This is not a role where you disappear and we trust you are busy. We measure outcomes.



Within 30 days:

? Marketing transition complete — all assets, accounts, and processes documented

? GBP fully optimized and active

? GA4 and Search Console reporting functional and clean

? Baseline audit report delivered



Within 90 days:

? Measurable increase in qualified inbound leads

? Improved Google Maps visibility and organic rankings

? Functional lead tracking dashboard in place

Ongoing:

????????????????????????????????????????

We are currently moving from an external marketing agency to a fully internal operation. This means we need someone who can stabilize fast — audit what exists, identify what is broken or missing, and immediately begin improving.



You will inherit existing accounts, campaigns, and content — some of which may need significant cleanup. The ability to diagnose, prioritize, and execute without drama is essential.

????????????????????????????????????????

title: Inbound Sales Appointment Setter (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

ABOUT US



We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years.



Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from
 and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon.



This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments.



- Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM 
 and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel

- Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close

- Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy)

- Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar

- Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day)

- Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time



The most important 
nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most.





KPI TARGETS



This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day.



- Calls per day: 150 to 250

- Leads worked per day: 17 to 25

- Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher

- Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file)

- Bookings per day: 4 to 9

- Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160





WHAT WE NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls.



The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. We need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months.

NICE TO HAVE

- Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon)

- Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care



COMPENSATION



- Base: $900 USD per month

- Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show

- Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows

- On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month

- PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period

- Payment: Paid through 
 on a regular schedule

- Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours.



To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here.





HOW TO APPLY

title: Behind-the-Scenes Cinematic TikTok Editor for Trading Card Brand (Long-Term)
description:
WE NEED THE EDITOR WHO MAKES OUR WAREHOUSE LOOK LIKE A DOCUMENTARY



I am hiring a part-time TikTok editor for a fast-growing Trading Card Game (TCG) content brand. This post is for editors who specialize in cinematic, documentary-style behind-the-scenes content.



Behind-the-scenes content builds trust because viewers see the real operation. We want editors who can take raw warehouse footage, inventory shots, packing sessions, and lifestyle 
nts, then turn them into cinematic 30-60 second pieces with strong visual storytelling. Think slower pacing, atmospheric music, layered B-roll, mood-driven edits.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- 5-8 BTS / documentary videos per day, Monday to Friday

- 30-60 second cinematic edits with B-roll, voiceover (if provided), atmospheric music

- Topics: warehouse tours, inventory shots, pack-opening sessions, day-in-the-life of running a TCG business, customer fulfillment scenes

- Strong cinematic pacing: slower cuts, mood setting, visual storytelling over verbal narration

- Color grading and exposure correction where needed

- Output 9:16 vertical, deliver via Drive



STYLE REFERENCE



Study cinematic short-form creators: travel filmmakers on TikTok, fashion BTS content, restaurant kitchen documentaries. Look for editors who think in mood and atmosphere, not just trends. 
 
 for our brand reference, but cinematic style will be more polished. These are reference accounts only, not the brand you will be editing for.



REQUIREMENTS



- 12+ months short-form video editing experience (higher bar for cinematic work)

- Portfolio with cinematic, documentary, travel, or fashion content

- Color grading proficiency (CapCut LUTs, Premiere Pro Lumetri, DaVinci Resolve color page)

- Comfortable with B-roll-heavy edits (visual storytelling without dialogue)

- Music selection and pacing skills

- Available Mon-Fri, 5 days/week, around 1.5 to 2 hours/day

- Filipino editors preferred for timezone alignment



BONUS POINTS



- Background in film school, photography, or travel content

- Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and titles

- Comfortable with cinematic LUTs and grading workflows

- Personal Instagram or portfolio site with cinematic content



COMPENSATION



PHP 16,800/month (paid weekly at PHP 4,200 every Friday). 5-8 cinematic videos/day x 5 days = 25-40 videos/week. Lower daily volume justified by craft-intensive editing. Performance bonuses after 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



In your application include:

1. 2-3 portfolio links showing your best cinematic or BTS editing work

2. Your usual turnaround time for one 30-60 second cinematic edit

3. Confirm you can commit to 5-8 cinematic videos/day, Mon-Fri

Applications missing the mood description will not be reviewed.



SELECTION PROCESS
