title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: 3D Modeller Needed for Production level Models
description:
Daily work available - $3 per 3D model for 3d printing 



I need a daily 3d modeller who thrives on consistent high-volume work. Monday through Friday work is available, $3 per 3d model paid weekly.  



You get to choose from a list of items to model that you may find interesting to model and provide the models as a file as a production ready final model.  These are not high res models, nor are they models that are textured or skinned.  They are low poly models designed for 3d printing.    



This is DAILY work with DAILY output expectations. If you prefer project-based or sporadic gigs, this isn't for you. If you want stable income doing the same thing well every single day, keep reading.



Job Requirements:



- fluent in written and spoken English

- have a video camera / web cam so that we can occasionally virtually meet for supervision and guidance and answer any of your questions to provide you support so you succeed

- 3d modelling ability to create assets and components for 3d printed production ready items .  The items are or components are generally less than 35 x 32 cm in size.  

- software used is Plasticity ( 
 ) knowledge is core, and much easier to use than Blender 3D

- 1 day turn around time

- multiple production schematics to create that you chose from daily

- completed items are sole ownership of the employer

- AI generation of 3D models is not accepted.  Thus, the original Plasticity model files are required as proof of work that is originally created by yourself (.plasticity file type).  

- plagiarism / copies of other creators work is also no acceptable - thus a web camera sharing your screen to confirm you are creating the 3d models and not plagiarizing is a requirement

- the models must minimize need for 3d printer supports and brims.  Thus, if you do not understand how to 3d model for 3d printers, this job is probably not for you.



WHAT DAILY WORK LOOKS LIKE:



Morning: Check Google folder which contains a list of work and select product items to model following specifications

Throughout day: Model products following specifications

By 9 PM Manila time: All models uploaded to Designated folder

Next morning: Repeat



- weekend work is negotiable, not required



APPLICATION STEPS (FOLLOW EXACTLY):



1. **SUBJECT LINE:** COMMITTED PLASTICITY 3D MODELLER



2. **FIRST LINE:** One sentence describing your expected Mon-Friday schedule



3. Questions to answer with your application (answer each with 1-3 sentences):

a) How long have you been 3d modelling

b) Provide a web URL of your modelling portfolio

c) If internet/power goes out during the day, what's your backup plan?

d) if given a list of 20 schematics to model within 24 hours, what is your methodology to have the work completed?

e) What are your weakest skills in 3d modelling?

f) Do you have any experience with printing products with 3d printers or using 3d printers?

g) Provide a sample of your work by using Plasticity to model a 20 cm long indoor bracket / coat hanger that can be mounted on the wall with 2 or 3 screw holders (7 mm diameter each), and has at least 2 hooks on it for a jacket and a hat to be held up, one on each hook.  You do not have to model the screws.  Do not texture the model.

h) If you disagree with an SOP direction but I tell you to do it anyway, what do you do?

i) Why are you reducing/leaving current work?

j) How many 3d models have you edited in the past 12 months?

---



Successful candidates will get a $30 paid trial of 1-1.5 hours of work demonstrating ability to 3d model and turn around times by producing production quality models that they are given to model.



AFTER TRIAL:



Pass the trial ? 2-week paid probation starts immediately 

During probation: Either side can end with 24 hours notice

After probation: 48 hour notice required from either side



Final hiring decision within 1 week of posting.



I'm not looking for the "best" modeller in the Philippines. I'm looking for someone who will show up every day, follow the standard operating procedure exactly, and still be working with me 12 months from now.



If that's you, apply carefully.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities:

Work closely with department leads across Marketing, Sales, Fulfillment, Technical, and Student Support to align efforts toward shared goals.

Serve as the central point of coordination for all operational initiatives across ExcelMindCyber.

Oversee scheduling, resource allocation, and instructor coordination to guarantee seamless program execution.

Continuously evaluate program delivery processes and implement improvements to elevate student outcomes.

Support Marketing and Sales teams with operational frameworks that drive lead generation, onboarding, and conversion efficiency.

Track and optimize the full student lifecycle from inquiry to course completion.



5.  Technical Operations

Collaborate with the Innovation/ Website and Communication team to maintain the reliability and performance of all learning platforms and digital infrastructure.

Oversee the operational rollout of new technical tools, learning management systems, and cybersecurity training environments.

Ensure technical operations align with international standards for cybersecurity education delivery.



6.  Process Automation & Operational Structure

Identify and implement automation solutions to eliminate manual, repetitive processes across departments.

Design and enforce a clear, scalable operational structure for the cybersecurity program, covering intake, delivery, assessment, and certification.

Build and maintain operational playbooks that ensure consistency and quality as the organization grows.



7.  Documentation & Workflow Management

Develop, maintain, and regularly update all standard operating procedures (SOPs), process maps, and workflow documentation.

Ensure all teams have access to up-to-date documentation and are trained to follow established procedures.

Build a centralized knowledge base that supports onboarding, audits, and continuous improvement efforts.

Partner with HR and team leads to monitor, track, and support staff performance across operations.

Facilitate performance review cycles, identify training needs, and support the professional development of operational staff.

Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.



9.  Student Experience

Champion a wholesome and positive experience for every student enrolled in an ExcelMindCyber program.

Establish feedback loops (surveys, check-ins, support tickets) to consistently monitor and improve the student journey.

Work with program and support teams to resolve student concerns quickly and maintain high satisfaction ratings.



10.  World-Class Standards & Strategic Growth

Drive initiatives that position ExcelMindCyber as a globally recognized, world-class cybersecurity training institution.

Benchmark operational practices against leading international training organizations and implement best practices.

Contribute to strategic planning by providing data-driven operational insights and recommendations to senior leadership.

title: : $585/Month TikTok/Reels Editor (CapCut, 45 Videos/Week, Long-Term)
description:

I need a daily short-form video editor who thrives on consistent high-volume work. 7 talking head videos every day, Monday through Saturday, $3 per video paid weekly.



This is DAILY work with DAILY output expectations. If you prefer project-based or sporadic editing gigs, this isn't for you. If you want stable income doing the same thing well every single day, keep reading.



WHAT DAILY WORK LOOKS LIKE:



Morning: Check Notion calendar for today's 7 videos (raw footage already uploaded, scripts provided)

Throughout day: Edit videos following my style guide (captions, cuts, pacing, occasional B-roll)

By 9 PM Manila time: All 7 videos uploaded to CapCut Space folder

Next morning: Repeat



Monday-Saturday schedule = 45 videos/week total, ~22 hours of work, $585/month ($3 per finished video).



Content focus is tech/EdTech (explaining apps, software, online learning), but you DON'T need prior tech portfolio. You need: ability to follow detailed SOPs, consistency, and reliability.



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE):



? 6+ months editing talking head UGC for TikTok/Reels/Shorts

? Active CapCut Space user (not Premiere, not DaVinci)

? Available Monday-Saturday INCLUDING weekends

? Backup internet (mobile hotspot) and power (UPS/generator)

? Currently working LESS than 15 hours/week for other clients

? Want per-video pay, not hourly rates

? Comfortable with 12+ month commitment



? DON'T APPLY IF:



- You edit music videos, dance content, wedding videos, corporate content, or long-form YouTube (this is talking head UGC ONLY)

- You can't work weekends (I film heavy Sat/Sun, need edits delivered same/next day)

- You want project-based work instead of daily volume

- You're juggling multiple clients and this would be "filler work"



WHAT YOU GET:



- CapCut Pro subscription (I pay)

- Video style guide covering captions, pacing, cuts

- Organized Notion workspace with calendar + scripts

- Weekly Friday payments via Wise (never late)

- 13th month bonus after 6 months

- One clear client, one editing style, predictable daily work



APPLICATION STEPS (FOLLOW EXACTLY):



1. **SUBJECT LINE:** COMMITTED CAPCUT EDITOR



2. **FIRST LINE:** One sentence describing your current Mon-Sat schedule



3. **PORTFOLIO:** 1 actual TikTok/Reel/Short link you edited



   Must be:

   - Published content (real TikTok/IG/YouTube link)

   - NOT Google Drive, Canva, or private folders

   - Talking head with captions (NOT music edits, montages, or B-roll only)

   

   Include:

   Link: [URL]

   Platform: [TikTok/Reels/Shorts]

   My role: [what you did]

   Software: [CapCut required]

   View count: [if visible]

   Turnaround time: [how long]



4. **8 QUESTIONS** (2-4 sentences each):



   - What's the most important thing about caption styling that bad editors get wrong?

   - How would you handle 15 raw videos delivered Sunday night with 7 needing Monday afternoon?

   - If internet/power goes out mid-day, what's your backup plan?

   - Name one CapCut feature or technique you learned in the last 60 days. Where?

   - If you disagree with an SOP direction but I tell you to do it anyway, what do you do?

   - What's your honest weakness as an editor? (Specific, not generic)

   - Why are you reducing/leaving current work?

   - How many short-form UGC videos have you edited in the past 12 months?



5. **ERROR TEST:** Find all errors in this caption:

   "im so exited for this there changing everything"



6. **CONFIRMATION:** "$3/video, 6 days/week, weekend work required, CapCut Space only, 12+ month commitment."



7. **CAPCUT SPACE FEATURE:** Name one CapCut Space feature you use regularly that most editors don't



8. **TAGALOG SENTENCE:** One sentence in Tagalog about why you want this role



PAID TRIAL PROCESS:



Strong applications get a paid trial within 24 hours.



Trial format:

- Watch 40 minutes of my style guide (4 specific sections)

- Edit 1 video matching my sample exactly

- Add provided B-roll and process it correctly

Total time: ~1-1.5 hours. Payment: $30 via Wise.



**B-roll is provided in trial materials. You MUST add it and process it per guide instructions. Skipping B-roll = automatic rejection.**



AFTER TRIAL:



Pass the trial ? 2-week paid probation starts immediately ($3/video from day 1)

Final hiring decision within 1 week of posting.



I'm not looking for the "best" editor in the Philippines. I'm looking for someone who will show up every day, follow the SOP exactly, and still be editing for me 12 months from now.

title: Podcast & Interview Video Editor (Part Time to Full Time)
description:
We are looking for a long-term video editor to help edit podcast episodes, talking-head / interview-style sessions, and short-form clips pulled from those recordings.



This role will start Part-time, but it will grow into a Full-time position as our podcast and interview content volume increases.



We are NOT looking for a one-time freelancer. We are looking for someone reliable, organized, detail-oriented, and excited to grow with the company long-term.



About the Role

You will mainly be editing podcast and interview-style content. This includes:

- Full podcast episodes

- Talking-head / interview-style sessions

- Short-form clips pulled from podcast or interview recordings

- Trailer / teaser clips from longer episodes or interviews



These short-form clips will be distributed on platforms like Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn, and other social platforms.



The style we are looking for is clean, modern, professional, and engaging. Not overly flashy, but polished, well-paced, and interesting to watch.



A big part of this role is being able to understand the conversation, catch strong 
nts, recognize good hooks, and turn longer recordings into short-form clips people want to watch.



Attention to detail matters a lot in this role. To show us you read the full post carefully, please include the word “timeline” in your application subject line. Applications without this may not be reviewed.



Workflow & Tools

- For full podcast episodes, our workflow will be a mix of manual editing and tools like AutoPod.

- AutoPod may help speed up the multi-camera editing process, but the final edit still needs human judgment, clean pacing, good timing, clear audio, and proper cuts.

- We may also use Opus Clip from time to time to test strong 
nts or when we need a quick turnaround for trailers, teasers, or short-form previews.



Preferred tools:

- Adobe Premiere Pro required

- AutoPod experience is a plus

- Opus Clip experience is a plus

- Basic After Effects skills are a plus



This is not a heavy motion graphics role. After Effects would only be used for light branded elements like lower thirds, title cards, logo animations, or simple graphics.



We are looking for someone who:

- Has experience editing podcast, interview, or talking-head content

- Understands how to create short-form clips from longer conversations

- Has strong English comprehension and attention to detail

- Is organized, reliable, and communicates clearly

- Can follow instructions and feedback carefully

- Wants a long-term opportunity



You do not need to speak perfect English, but you do need to understand spoken English well enough to follow the conversation, select strong 
nts, and make sure captions are accurate.



Starting Hours

This role will start part-time, likely around 10–20 hours per week depending on workload and gradually expand.

As our podcast and interview content grows, this role will grow into a full-time position for the right person.



To Apply, please send:

- An introduction about yourself

- Examples of podcast, interview, talking-head, or short-form clips you have edited

- What software and tools you use

- Your expected hourly rate or monthly part-time rate

- How many hours per week you are currently available



Please also answer these questions:

- What makes a short-form podcast/interview clip interesting enough for someone to stop scrolling?

- Have you edited multi-camera podcast or interview content before?

- Have you used AutoPod or Opus Clip before?



Thank you,

Neo

This is NOT a traditional editing role.

We don’t need pretty edits — we need performance-driven creatives.



Important Context:

We don’t have a large library of original footage.

Your strength should be in sourcing, remixing, and building compelling visuals using:

Social media clips (TikTok, IG, YouTube)

B-rolls

AI-generated assets



What You’ll Be Doing:

- Turn scripts into high-converting video ads

- Visually communicate exactly what the script is saying (this is key)

- Source clips that match the story, pain points, and emotions in the script

- Use B-rolls and overlays to reinforce key claims and benefits

- Create multiple variations (hooks, angles, pacing) for testing

- Use AI tools to enhance production speed and creative output



What We Mean by “Direct Response Editor”:



- You don’t just edit… you translate persuasion into visuals.



If a script says:



“Your dog is silently suffering from joint pain…”

 - You show subtle signs of pain, slower movement, emotional cues



If a script says:



“Within weeks, owners noticed their dogs running again…”

- You show transformation, energy, before/after contrast



You understand:

- Hooks = scroll stopping visuals

- Pain points = emotionally compelling clips

- Benefits = clear, believable outcomes



Your job is to make the viewer feel and believe the script, not just hear it.





What We’re Looking For:



- Strong understanding of direct response / performance marketing

- Experience editing UGC-style ads

- Ability to match visuals to script messaging perfectly

- Skilled at sourcing and repurposing content

- Great instinct for pacing, hooks, and retention

- CapCut / Premiere Pro / After Effects

This Role Is Perfect For You If:



- You think like a marketer, not just an editor

- You know how to make people stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds

- You can turn simple clips into ads that sell

- You’re resourceful and fast



How to Apply:

How you approach turning a script into visuals

title: Scalable Next.js Commerce Upgrade
description:
I’m moving the production e-commerce platform from a brittle monolith to a fully-type-safe stack based on Next.js v14, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Auth.js, and Stripe. The immediate, highest-priority task is a thorough refactor of the existing legacy codebase so we can eliminate the high server response times that are slowing checkout and catalogue pages.  



Once the worst bottlenecks are gone, the roadmap continues with clean REST/GraphQL APIs and a hardened Stripe integration, all built with TDD and modern best practices in mind. You’ll be working inside a GitHub repo with CI already wired for Jest and ESLint; every merge must keep tests green and Lighthouse scores healthy.



Key context you should know:

• Current pain point: performance inefficiencies, specifically high server response times.  

• Tech already in place: Next.js 14 on the front end, NestJS services layer, PostgreSQL 15, Auth.js for sessions, Stripe for payments.  

• Priority order: 1) Refactor legacy code, 2) Build clean APIs, 3) Finalise secure payments.



Deliverables (acceptance criteria):

1. Refactored modules pass existing unit tests plus any you add, with p95 API response < 200 ms under 500 concurrent users (k6 script provided).  

2. New or updated endpoints documented via OpenAPI and verified with Postman collection.  

3. Stripe checkout flow completed end-to-end in test mode, with webhook handling and graceful failure paths.  

4. Pull-request walkthrough recorded (loom or similar) so my in-house team can follow architectural decisions.



If you’ve shipped something similar—ideally with Next.js + NestJS—and can point to benchmarks or repo snippets, that will help me shortlist quickly. Feel free to DM links to live demos, PRs, or case studies.

title: Senior Creative Strategist & Performance Video Editor (Meta Ads)

Senior Creative Strategist & Performance Video Editor (Meta Ads)

This is not a media buyer position.



This is not a role for someone who simply repurposes trends or creates aesthetically pleasing videos.



We are looking for someone who understands how to identify opportunities in a market, uncover customer insights, develop winning concepts, execute those concepts into high-performing ads, analyze performance data, and continuously improve creatives through structured feedback loops.



You will be responsible for the entire creative process:



Research ? Strategy ? Concept Development ? Editing ? Testing ? Iteration



Minimum Requirements



* 5+ years of experience working with eCommerce brands

* Proven experience creating profitable Meta ad creatives

* Demonstrated understanding of direct-response marketing

* Experience working with brands spending meaningful budgets on Meta

* Strong portfolio of performance-focused creatives

* Ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind every creative decision



Applications without relevant eCommerce and direct-response experience will not be considered.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Market Research



* Deep research into our customers, competitors, and market

* Analyze customer reviews, Reddit discussions,
 groups, comments, support tickets, competitor ads, and other research sources

* Identify customer pain points, frustrations, objections, desires, and buying motivations

* Continuously discover new creative opportunities



Creative Strategy



* Develop new angles, concepts, hooks, and messaging frameworks

* Build concepts based on research and evidence rather than assumptions

* Present clear reasoning behind why a creative should perform before it is produced

* Create testing plans and creative hypotheses



Creative Production



* Turn your concepts into finished advertisements

* Edit short-for
ta and TikTok ads

* Create multiple hook variations and creative iterations

* Source footage and supporting assets

* Leverage AI tools when appropriate to improve execution



Creative Analysis & Feedback Loops



* Review creative performance regularly

* Analyze winners and losers

* Identify why creatives succeeded or failed

* Build improved iterations based on real-world results

* Continuously refine concepts and messaging based on performance data



We are not interested in:



* "Let's test it and see what happens"

* Random creative ideas with no supporting research

* Repeating the same concept with slightly different hooks

* Surface-level competitor research



Every concept should have a clear rationale backed by customer insights, market research, or previous performance data.



AI Experience (Required)



You must already have access to and experience with modern AI creative tools.



Examples include:



* Higgsfield

* Runway

* Kling

* Veo

* Midjourney

* Flux

* ElevenLabs

* Similar industry-leading tools



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Generate hyper-realistic scenes

* Improve storytelling

* Increase creative production speed and quality



What Success Looks Like



* New concepts are consistently generated from research

* Every creative has a clear strategic reason for existing

* Winning concepts are identified and scaled quickly

* Losing concepts are analyzed and improved through structured feedback loops

* Creative quality and performance improve over time

* The creative system becomes more intelligent with every test



Application Requirements

2. Examples of creatives that produced strong results

3. Relevant performance metrics (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, etc.)

4. The research process behind at least one winning creative

5. The AI tools you currently use

6. A brief explanation of how you would research and develop concepts for a new product from scratch



Important



We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.



Someone who takes responsibility for the creative outcome, continuously learns from performance data, and is obsessed with understanding customers and creating better advertising.



If you have a proven history of building winning concepts, executing them at a high level, and improving them through research and feedback loops, we would love to hear from you.

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 25,000 - 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier, distributor, and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade, wholesale, and e-commerce. We are building Amazon wholesale and private label operations in Canada and the United States, with a focus on long-term supplier relationships, organized execution, and data-driven decision-making. Our company values professionalism, clear communication, and practical execution. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist to execute and manage key parts of our Amazon wholesale workflow across Canada and the United States. This role combines Amazon wholesale product research, supplier sourcing, distributor and brand outreach, account applications, onboarding, follow-ups, and daily workflow execution.



This is a main execution role, not a passive support role. The main purpose is to find and validate viable Amazon wholesale opportunities, build and manage the supplier pipeline, keep supplier and product files organized, and move the workflow forward without constant supervision.

The exact focus may shift depending on business priorities, supplier responses, available catalogs, and current workflow bottlenecks.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or basic admin experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon product research, Amazon wholesale, supplier sourcing, supplier communication, or Amazon operations experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon wholesale product research using Amazon, Keepa, SellerAmp, Seller Central, Google Sheets, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Evaluate product demand, pricing, Buy Box behavior, FBA competition, seller count, Amazon presence, reviews, sales rank, gating status, brand restrictions, and estimated profitability.

• Screen supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, brand search results, distributor product lists, and product files to identify viable Amazon wholesale opportunities.

• Research and identify potential wholesale distributors, brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in Canada and the United States.

• Contact suppliers, distributors, and brands by
 or web form and follow up professionally.

• Complete wholesale account applications, supplier forms, distributor onboarding forms, and account setup documents.

• Request and organize wholesale pricing, catalogs, MOQ, case pack details, stock availability, lead times, shipping terms, payment terms, and account requirements.

• Confirm whether suppliers allow Amazon, FBA, online marketplace sales, reseller accounts, or require written marketplace approval.

• Maintain supplier trackers, distributor trackers, application status sheets, outreach logs, product screening files, and follow-up lists.

• Organize supplier folders, application screenshots, pricing lists, catalog files, account notes, product research notes, and communication records in Google Drive.

• Coordinate with prep centers, suppliers, distributors, and internal tea
mbers when needed.

• Use AI tools to draft, organize, summarize, and check work, while carefully verifying accuracy.

• Prepare clear daily updates showing completed work, links, blockers, risks, and next steps.

• Flag supplier issues, application blockers, missing documents, marketplace restrictions, pricing problems, weak products, poor-fit suppliers, or workflow delays early.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA wholesale experience required, including Amazon product research, wholesale product screening, supplier sourcing, distributor outreach, brand outreach, Amazon operations, and wholesale account setup.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

• Strong understanding of wholesale product viability, including demand, pricing, competition, Buy Box, seller count, Amazon presence, fees, profitability, gating, and brand restrictions.

• Strong written English and professional supplier communication skills.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple product research tasks, supplier conversations, applications, files, follow-ups, and status trackers at the same time.

• Comfortable following SOPs, checklists, templates, company instructions, policies, and structured workflows.

• Strong attention to detail with product data, pricing, supplier information, application forms, account requirements, and status tracking.

• Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and keep work moving without constant supervision.

• Comfortable asking clear questions, reporting blockers early, and providing practical updates.

• Must be comfortable with both Amazon product research and supplier-side communication, not only one side of the workflow.

• Must be reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily execution.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.



KPIs / Success Measures:



• Quality and accuracy of Amazon wholesale product research and screening decisions.

• Ability to identify viable wholesale opportunities and reject weak products or poor-fit suppliers quickly.

• Number and quality of relevant suppliers, distributors, brands, catalogs, and product opportunities researched.

• Quality and consistency of supplier, distributor, and brand outreach.

• Accuracy and completeness of wholesale applications, onboarding files, supplier records, and product research files.

• Speed and quality of follow-ups without losing professionalism or accuracy.

• Organization of Google Drive folders, trackers, supplier records, product screening files, and daily work files.

• Ability to identify supplier restrictions, Amazon marketplace issues, gating issues, application blockers, pricing issues, and workflow risks early.

• Low error rate in forms, supplier details, pricing data, product information, and tracking sheets.

• Clear communication of completed work, blockers, risks, action items, and next steps.

• Ability to take ownership of the wholesale workflow and improve execution over time.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.



What We Offer:



• Full-time remote/hybrid work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon wholesale business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across Amazon product research, wholesale sourcing, supplier operations, and marketplace expansion.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior role as the business reaches revenue and expands.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.
